title: 11 Best Montale Perfumes: Oud, Rose & More
summary: Discover 11 of the best Montale perfumes, from Arabians Tonka and Intense Cafe to Roses Musk, with notes, scent profiles, and top picks.
body_markdown:
The Montale story kicked off in 2001, when Pierre Montale, perfumer, visionary, and oud whisperer, was summoned to the Middle East to craft exclusive scents for Saudi royalty. Immersed in a world of opulence and tradition, Montale mastered the art of blending East and West. He bottles rich oud, Bulgarian rose, spices, resins, and florals into unforgettable fragrances. Today, the best Montale perfumes bring that signature style to life through bold, comforting, and long-lasting compositions.


In the West, perfume seduces. In the East, it soothes. Montale? He does both. His fragrances are time machines made for the present and the future: Comforting, nostalgic, bold, and built to linger.


## **11 Best Montale Perfumes to Try**


Every Montale creation bears Pierre’s full imprint, from the first spark of inspiration to the final spritz, crafted with precision, passion, and a heavy dose of oud.


When you wear Montale, you’re wearing a statement. A memory. A masterpiece.


**Ready to Smell Legendary?**


If you’re over basic bottles with zero ambition and ready for fragrance with a backstory, you’re in the right place.


Go ahead. Fall in love with one or all. Call us smug, but we think it will be the latter, after all. No, wait, we know you’ll love all of these.


### 1. Montale Arabians Tonka EDP


The master perfumer believes oud is the gatekeeper of Eastern heritage, and in Montale Arabians Tonka EDP, this decadent woody aroma takes center stage. The fragrance blends oud with enchanting rose, tonka bean, saffron, amber, oakmoss, bergamot, and white musk. This fragrance is a tribute to Arabic horses, and its composition highlights the animalic and racy characteristics of oud.[Try Montale Arabians Tonka EDP NOW](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/montale-arabians-tonka-3569) .


### 2. Intense Cafe EDP


Montale Intense Cafe EDP celebrates the love affair between coffee and rose. A spritz of this Montale perfume feels like taking a sip of strong espresso in a decadent café. The tempting scent blends bright florals, vanilla, amber, and white musk with the alluring key notes of coffee and rose. If you want a scent that will take your mind to your favorite café memory, this is the top pick.[Try Montale Intense Cafe EDP NOW](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/montale-intense-cafe-185) .


### 3. Roses Musk EDP


Just imagine: Roses with dew drops blending with skin-like musk — this is what you’ll smell in Montale Roses Musk EDP. You’ll also pick up hints of sweetness in this floral, woody, musky scent. Montale believes it is best to leave “perfection uncluttered.” This minimalistic blend of rose and musk is uplifting and alluring at the same time, giving you the best of both worlds in one flawless formula.[Try Montale Roses Musk EDP NOW](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/montale-roses-musk-184) .


### 4. Lucky Candy EDP


Feeling lucky? Then you’ll adore Montale Lucky Candy EDP. This sweet floral fragrance will charm you from the first whiff with honey, cacao, and bergamot. The gourmand top notes softly fold into more sweetness like marshmallow, coconut cream, vanilla, and toffee. Once these tempting aromas have satisfied your sweet tooth, you’ll also smell florals like frangipani and lily of the valley. This Montale perfume will hit the sweet spot every time![Try Montale Lucky Candy EDP NOW](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/montale-lucky-candy-3568) .


### 5. Oud Tobacco EDP


You wouldn’t want to miss Montale perfume’s take on oud… with tobacco and hints of tonka! Montale Oud Tobacco EDP opens with zesty citrus, cumin, and red sumac that wake the senses before fusing into incense, orange blossom, tobacco, and oud. The dusting of tonka bean awaits in the drydown, where the scent becomes truly intoxicating.


### 6. Oud Pashmina EDP


Get a completely unique twist on oud with Montale Oud Pashmina EDP. This luxurious Montale perfume wraps you in a cloud of decadent oud that features characteristics like dark wood, amber, and leather and has an instant hypnotic effect on the senses. Notes like rose, grey musk, and vanilla highlight the oud accord that becomes more alluring as it lingers on your skin throughout the day.


### 7. Intense Pepper EDP


Give your senses a wake-up call with Montale Intense Pepper EDP. This fresh, spicy fragrance gives your senses an invigorating blast with black pepper, lemon, and pink pepper. The fragrant spices fuse into florals before drying down into oud, cedar, white musk, and amber. If you love spices, this Montale perfume is a must!


### 8. Velvet Fantasy EDP


Make fantasy a reality with Montale’s Velvet Fantasy EDP. This dreamy perfume is a blend of fruits, solar notes, violet, rose, white musk, incense, and amber. This Montale perfume will transport you to an enchanting world where the most decadent aromas of your dreams become real.


### 9. Red Vetiver EDP


If you love vetiver, you’ve found your match in Red Vetiver EDP. This unique version of vetiver charms with cedar, patchouli leaves, grapefruit, elemi, and black pepper. You’ll smell the vetiver aroma from the first spritz all the way through to the drydown. If you love Eastern-inspired woody fragrances, you can’t go wrong with this Montale perfume.


### 10. Crazy In Love EDP


Who doesn’t want to be “crazy in love”? Crazy In Love EDP celebrates the wonder of love with wild roses, saffron, violet leaves, and a hit of amber. Feel the emotion and connection with this Montale perfume that captures your heart with brown sugar and vanilla bean. This scent will warm your soul and ignite your passion.


### 11. Herbal Aquatica EDP


Herbal Aquatica EDP delivers a tranquil mix of aromas that calm the mind. This Montale perfume holds your attention with an opening of mint, herbal notes, sage, and bergamot. The heart reveals soothing marine-inspired aromas with lotus, sea notes, green tea, and papyrus. The base holds the formula together with a blend of sandalwood, vanilla sugar, and amber. This one-of-a-kind Montale perfume is inspired by a journey on the Nile, and the scent makes you inhale the splashes from the river as you cruise through ancient Egypt.


## **FAQ Section**


**What is Montale perfume known for?**
Montale is known for bold, long-lasting fragrances inspired by both Middle Eastern and Western perfumery. Many Montale perfumes feature oud alongside notes such as rose, musk, amber, vanilla, spices, and woods.


**What are some of the best Montale perfumes?**
Popular Montale fragrances featured in this guide include Arabians Tonka, Intense Cafe, Roses Musk, Lucky Candy, Oud Tobacco, Oud Pashmina, Intense Pepper, and Red Vetiver. The best choice depends on the notes and fragrance family you prefer.


**What does Montale Arabians Tonka smell like?**
Montale Arabians Tonka is a rich woody fragrance combining oud with rose, tonka bean, saffron, amber, oakmoss, bergamot, and white musk. Its profile is warm, bold, spicy, and sweet.


**What does Montale Intense Cafe smell like?**
Montale Intense Cafe combines coffee and rose with floral notes, vanilla, amber, and white musk. The result is a sweet, warm gourmand-floral fragrance with a distinctive coffee accord.


**Which Montale perfume is best for oud lovers?**
Oud lovers can explore Montale Arabians Tonka, Oud Tobacco, and Oud Pashmina. Arabians Tonka pairs oud with rose and saffron, Oud Tobacco adds tobacco and spices, while Oud Pashmina combines oud with rose, musk, and vanilla.d a heavy dose of oud.
